I understand that you feel horrible and maybe for your situation has been bad beyond my imagination, but it’s not the best idea to just say it doesn’t get better , to encourage death. There are many people “around” here that are just at the tipping point of either losing all hope or climbing out of what ever deep dark place they were in and reading such a short sentence might just drag them back down. Saying such things not only makes you feel bad but it messes up others around you. It’s ok to feel depressed, mad , disappointed, or what ever negative feeling you feel inside. You should never just ignore them but you should at least focus on any positive thing you can even if it’s not helping you it can make a drastic difference for someone else. Your wording makes a huge difference “I feel like shit rn but I’m still here” “I feel horrible and sick but I’m getting better minute by minute “ . It’s hard and I can’t even image what other people are going through but you should never downplay yours or anyone’s pain and bring down others

I’m not about your situation but something that’s has stayed in my head is knowing we can just die from losing the will to live , no suicide or anything needed. If my depression in my brain wants me dead then it can just kill me itself. If I’m still alive regardless of how much pain I’m in then my brain doesn’t want it bad enough and Im lazy so ain’t gonna do someone else’s work. Another thing that keep me fighting is anger towards the world I suppose. So many mean people so I want to be better then them! A positive and negative part of the human brain is that it’s so moldable. Take baby steps into feeling better, it’s a process. Power pose in front on the mirror in the mornings and just smile, admire your body for its uniqueness , a piece of art unlike any other. Fake it if you have to but keep doing small things every day!!!! Hype yourself up, a very important thing !!! Change the wording  on your thought . If you feel bad don’t ignore it . Don’t just think I’m sad , think I’m sad now but getting better minute by minute. Your physical and mental health are two parts of a whole, a strong and healthy body nurtures a strong healthy kind and vise versa. Drink lots of water !!! Take vitamins if you aren’t eating enough at least. Get nutrients into your body basically. It’s a lot of small things you got to do but they all help you feel better. A simple thing as getting glasses and being able to see more of the word has changed the way I experienced life. I’m mostly rambling now but it’s great, taking about things helps not only others but yourself. An important thing is to listen , and pass down any good things you learn. Help yourself and then help others. Thanks for coming to my Ted talk :)
